notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello racers,

we are getting a lot of feedback from Steam and Switch users and it is being quite useful to improve the game.
Patch 1.0.9 includes a major change in the shooting mechanic:

-Auto-shooting is now only enabled when the target is being moved. So the ship will not shot until the player decides so. It does not take too much time to get used to new behaviour, and we think it improves the player´s feeling.

-The turbos counter is now placed on the bottom box.

-We have increased handling speed of all ships, making them more responsive.

-The initial energy af all ships has been also increased.

-When a barricade is hit, it disappears sooner.

-Improved GUI on King of the Galaxy mode.

-Some circuits layout and elements has been tweaked.

We hope you like this new update, and if you have any question or suggestion, just use the discussion forum.

Cheers

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
New patch with lot of improvements:

-Added restart / exit button on finish circuit / ship destroyed screen.
-Changed badge times in some circuits.
-Tweaked some circuit elements layout.
-Fixed start/end sign text bug in last lap.
-Improved shot precission. Not ghost collisions anymore.
-Slightly improved performance with explosions and particles.
-Changed finish circuit / ship destroyed camera animation.

We hope you are enjoying the game, if you find any issue or have any suggestion to make, just write on the discussions forum.

Cheers
